perspective:
Vincent Chinana’s accessible information:

- He knows his own identity as Vincent Chinana, a mechanic. He knows Patrick Guzman as a long-time friend from their teenage years; they share a blue-collar bond and have often collaborated, combining Vincent’s mechanical skills with Patrick’s construction expertise.
- At the diner: Vincent hears Patrick considering a new construction venture, sees it as a good opportunity to expand his business, thinks it is worth the risk, and is still weighing options. Vincent says he has heard it is risky, worries about financial security, and suggests reconsidering or delaying for more information. He hears Patrick thank him and say he will think it over more.
- After a few days / at Patrick’s construction site: Vincent notices Patrick avoiding detailed discussion of the investment. Vincent tells Patrick he feels Patrick is not telling him everything. He hears Patrick say it is complicated and that he did not want to worry Vincent with details. Vincent expresses feeling betrayed by the lack of transparency. He hears Patrick apologize, say he should have been more open, and propose sitting down to explain everything.
- At Vincent’s garage: Vincent hears Patrick say the situation is serious and tough, and that Patrick might lose a significant amount if it does not turn around soon. Vincent offers to lend Patrick money to cover short-term losses. He hears Patrick thank him and express gratitude for the support.
- At the coffee shop: Vincent says/believes the venture might actually turn a profit. He hears Patrick confirm it is starting to look up and that Patrick is relieved they stuck with it. Vincent apologizes for doubting him earlier and proposes a joint venture, saying he now sees potential. He hears Patrick agree and say they should work out the details.
- At Vincent’s house: Vincent says combining their skills can make the venture a success. He hears Patrick agree and say he is excited. Vincent proposes starting the business plan and outlining every step carefully. He hears Patrick agree to cover all bases and set it up for success.
- Vincent knows he and Patrick are optimistic about their joint venture and are drafting a business plan together.

He does not have access to Patrick’s private thoughts or any unspoken information beyond what Patrick said or what Vincent directly observed.
